ArtifactMetadata.Summary: Added wishlist dropdown preview to desktop Navbar.jsx. Exposed ids in useWishlist and fetched wishlist items in Navbar.jsx.

args.Description: Implemented a wishlist preview dropdown on the desktop Navbar. Instead of forcing guest users to sign in by redirecting to the user panel, they can now click the wishlist icon to see their wishlisted items in a beautiful dropdown, add them to the cart without authentication, and only get prompted to log in at checkout.
args.Instruction: Add wishlist dropdown preview and useWishlist hook integration.
